plan: Given the value of $39, I should bid slightly less to maximize profit while still having a chance to win. In this auction, my goal is to maximize profit, which is the difference between my value for the prize and my bid. Given my value of $27, I should bid slightly less to ensure a positive profit if I win. Rational bidders will also bid below their values. A bid slightly below my value, such as $26.8, balances winning chances and profit.
